findings.summary: The official selection-to-paper pipeline is stopped: the latest three scheduled runs fail at the verified risk-outcome parent restore gate.
P0-5 must establish the quarantined legacy risk-outcome parent before normal paper continuation; no automatic or inferred bootstrap is allowed.
The main repository latest full-rebuild alias diverges from its nearest immutable run in scored_latest.csv, so approved-run reproduction is blocked.
Historical R1000 membership is explicitly not PIT-safe and only two 2026 monthly snapshots were observed, creating survivorship risk in backtests and training.
Macro snapshots have three same-path writers, while the crisis monitor has no current-session maximum-age check for long-crisis features.
The free price manifest refreshes 80 tickers with required_ticker_count=0 and exact_operating_universe=false; it is proxy readiness, not selector readiness.
Drive model and feature objects are stale latest-only aliases without immutable training lineage; the scoring metadata is non-strict JSON because it contains NaN.
Drive price-cache enumeration is incomplete (100 returned versus 1048 reported), so duplicate/orphan and full hash claims fail closed.
Every Drive restore/persist path depends on an rclone shared Google Drive client ID that runtime logs warn is being retired during 2026.
Git tracks 6.8GB of full-rebuild artifacts across 10,460 blobs, increasing checkout, clone, review, and CI latency.
A stale Drive source mirror and repeated same-name folders can be mistaken for canonical storage unless folder IDs and parent paths are enforced.
Form 4 storage exposes 36 of 40 numbered shard folders while the completed merge manifest reports 38 source files; the difference needs a signed reconciliation manifest.

migration_items.title: Complete P0-5 legacy risk-outcome parent acceptance
migration_items.current_state: Normal daily operating runs fail closed before market snapshot, target, and ledger processing.
migration_items.required_change: Use the separate P0-5 procedure to verify and accept exactly one quarantined legacy outcome parent with explicit one-time owner authorization.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Verified immutable accepted-head manifest, exact parent/child continuity, one successful scheduled continuation, and no target/ledger/live mutation outside the authorized paper transaction.
migration_items.safety_boundary: No automatic dispatch, no genesis bootstrap by inference, no live trading, and no use of folder-name trust.

migration_items.title: Remove expiring-artifact dependence from accepted recovery evidence
migration_items.current_state: Catch-up verifies a pinned GitHub artifact digest; GitHub artifacts expire even though derived Drive evidence exists.
migration_items.required_change: Publish the exact artifact bytes or a complete content-addressed extraction into immutable durable storage, preserving GitHub run/artifact IDs and API/ZIP digest.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Offline verifier reconstructs the approved price-only evidence from the durable immutable bundle after GitHub artifact expiry.
migration_items.safety_boundary: Price replay only; never inherit target, ledger, promotion, production, or broker authority from a failed source run.

migration_items.title: Create immutable run bundle for the divergent scored universe
migration_items.current_state: latest_global_alpha_universe differs from its nearest dated run in scored_latest.csv.
migration_items.required_change: Assign the exact latest tree a new immutable run/session directory and manifest containing code/config/data/universe/source hashes.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: The latest alias resolves byte-for-byte to one immutable tree and the validator rejects any one-file divergence.
migration_items.safety_boundary: No fullrun, strategy change, or target publication is implied.

migration_items.title: Establish PIT universe and identity history
migration_items.current_state: Historical membership is a proxy and only March/April 2026 monthly snapshots were observed.
migration_items.required_change: Archive licensed or documented membership snapshots with available_from, effective dates, delistings, ticker/CUSIP changes, and universe hashes.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Representative backtest dates resolve to exactly one hash-bound membership snapshot without current-membership fallback.
migration_items.safety_boundary: Do not claim official Russell membership where the source license or history is unavailable.

migration_items.title: Consolidate macro writer authority and enforce current-session freshness
migration_items.current_state: Three workflows can overwrite same-date/latest macro files, and crisis availability compares a feature date to itself.
migration_items.required_change: Designate one macro writer, use atomic content-addressed daily manifests, record component available_from/provider hashes, and compare maximum age against the actual decision session.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Stale long-crisis features deterministically yield DEGRADED_DATA; same-date second writes are rejected or create a new immutable revision.
migration_items.safety_boundary: The crisis monitor remains advisory and cannot place trades or mutate official targets.

migration_items.title: Separate proxy price readiness from exact selector coverage
migration_items.current_state: The free manifest reports 80 refreshed tickers, required_ticker_count=0, and exact_operating_universe=false.
migration_items.required_change: Bind price coverage to the exact candidate/target ticker identity set and require per-ticker through-date, provider, adjustment, and content hashes.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Coverage ratio is bounded 0..1 over exact ticker identities, required_ticker_count is positive, and no stale ticker can pass.
migration_items.safety_boundary: Proxy replay may remain available but cannot satisfy the official daily selection freshness gate.

migration_items.title: Version model and feature bundles
migration_items.current_state: Models and features are latest-only April/June objects with missing lineage and non-strict JSON metadata.
migration_items.required_change: Create immutable training bundles with finite strict JSON, code/config/data/universe hashes, feature schema, evaluation windows, and rollback pointer.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: A clean environment reproduces scoring from one manifest and rejects NaN/Infinity or an unbound latest alias.
migration_items.safety_boundary: No automatic champion promotion; research-only until a separate approval gate accepts the bundle.

migration_items.title: Replace retiring shared rclone client configuration
migration_items.current_state: GitHub logs warn the shared Google Drive client ID will stop working during 2026.
migration_items.required_change: Provision a dedicated Google Drive OAuth client/service configuration through approved secret management and test bounded read-only enumeration first.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Restore and persistence preflights pass without the retirement warning; credentials remain absent from artifacts and logs.
migration_items.safety_boundary: Secret values are never committed, printed, or included in the inventory.

migration_items.title: Move large historical results behind immutable manifests
migration_items.current_state: Git tracks 6.8GB of full-rebuild history and duplicate latest copies.
migration_items.required_change: After a separately approved migration, retain compact manifests and durable content-addressed artifacts instead of repeated large Git blobs.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: Fresh clone and CI checkout sizes fall materially while every approved run remains reproducible by manifest.
migration_items.safety_boundary: No Git history rewrite, deletion, or large-file move is authorized by P0-4.

migration_items.title: Reconcile SEC shards and duplicate Drive namespaces
migration_items.current_state: Shard folder numbering and merge source counts are not explicitly reconciled; stale same-name roots exist.
migration_items.required_change: Publish a signed shard index with expected IDs/content hashes and a canonical parent-ID registry; quarantine duplicates by evidence, not name.
migration_items.acceptance_evidence: All expected shards are present or explicitly superseded, merge inputs hash exactly, and canonical paths resolve by parent IDs.
migration_items.safety_boundary: No Drive rename, move, or deletion without a separate cleanup approval.
